> 第3831章 下场（第1页）
锦袍男子看到对方居然像个树桩一样，傻傻的站在那里，没有动作，以为对方是吓傻了，露出了得意的笑容，心道不过是一个装货而已，终究要原形毕露的，可他根本没有观察对方的神色，但凡观察了，就不会这么想了。
他同样没注意到，那几名女子同样是一副淡定从容的模样，好像跟没事人一样。
电光火石间，他们的长枪就刺在了苏长歌的身体上。
然而令他们毛骨悚然，难以置信的事情出现了。
只见钢铁与血肉之躯撞击在一起的时候，他们的枪尖居然直接弯裂，火星子四溅，一个眨眼就在一阵噼里啪啦的爆响声中炸成了碎片，连带着他们的手都没有感觉了，仿佛丧失了知觉一般。
这是怎么回事？对方竟然能从的承受住他们的一枪而毫发无伤，简直是太恐怖了！
卧槽，这人究竟是什么来历？怎么会如此强横？
我的老天爷，我的眼睛是不是出现幻觉，对方为何没事，反倒是他们的长枪居然被毁了，这也太匪夷所思了吧？！
就在他们愣神之际，苏长歌抖动了一下身体，这些人冷不防，立刻朝四面八方被震飞了出去，而后狠狠的摔在地上。
随后，苏长歌冷笑一声，嘲笑道：“你的手下就这点能耐吗？那可杀不了我哦，我还以为你的手下有多厉害，原来这么弱，这么不堪一击啊，真是让人大跌眼镜！”
紫月忍不住落井下石道：“就是啊，你莫不是脑子坏掉了，就凭这些垃圾，还想对我们不利，简直是痴人说梦！”
明月也跟着吐槽道：“有病就去治脑子，别在这里发癫了！”
“他马上就要死了，还治什么脑子，真是浪费，这种没脑子的人直接杀了就行，省的浪费天地资源！”叶清瑶也加入进来。
听到这些人的嘲笑和讥讽，锦袍男子的脸色别提有多难看了。
他不服气的狡辩道：“你休要得得意，刚刚只不过是试一下你的深浅，不过是开胃小菜而已，真正的杀招还没开始！”
苏长歌微微一笑，不以为意的道：“是吗？还有什么杀招，尽管来吧，我倒要看看你口中的杀招有多厉害。”
不管对方口中的杀招有多么厉害，在他眼里，其实都跟小儿科没什么两样，毕竟他的修为已经是顶级了，根本就看不上。
锦袍男子信誓旦旦开口道：“哼，一旦将杀招祭出，你必将死无全尸！”
随后，他朝几名随从喝道：“一群废物，本公子的脸面和尊严都被快你们丢光了，要你们有何用？再给你们一次机会，务必将他给我杀掉，要不然你们以后就没资格继续待在本公子身边。”
“公子放心，我们定会将他碎尸万段，给公子泄愤！”
“是的，刚刚确实是我们大意了，以为对方只是一个小趴菜，没太当回事，没想到居然被对方给算计了，不管怎么说是我们失误了，都是我们的错，保证绝不会再有下次了！”
“公子莫动怒，我们几人的能力，公子想必也知道的，刚刚只是一次失误而已，他得意不了多久了！”
“我们现在就将他给拿下，让公子消气！”
听到这话，锦袍男子的脸色缓和了一些，冷声道：“希望这次你们别再让本公子失望了，要不然，你们会是什么下场，不用我说，你们应该也很清楚！”
听到“下场”二字，这四名随从心中一紧，脸色难看无比，忍不住倒吸一口凉气。
公子对他们的要求很严格，若是让他不满意，那么等待他们的将是各种惩罚，轻的是调走，重则废掉修为，甚至是处死。
据说，上一批是跟在公子身边的侍卫，办事不合公子的心意，有的被公子的父亲废掉了修为，有的直接连命都没有了。
这些手段，他们光想想都觉得可怕，他们可不想落到这种下场，所以他们肯定会全力以赴。
这时，苏长歌淡淡一笑，提议道：“好心提醒你一句，你若想打赢我，靠他们是不行的。”

> Chapter 3831 Ending (Page 1)
The man in the brocade robe saw that the other party was like a tree stump, standing there stupidly without moving. He thought that the other party was frightened and showed a proud smile. He thought that it was just a pretense and his true colors would eventually be revealed. However, he did not observe the other party's expression at all. If he did, he would not think so.
He also didn't notice that the women also looked calm and calm, as if nothing was wrong.
In a flash of lightning, their spears pierced Su Changge's body.
However, something horrifying and unbelievable happened to them.
When steel and flesh and blood collided together, the tips of their spears actually bent and cracked, sparks flew everywhere, and exploded into pieces in a burst of crackling explosions in the blink of an eye. They could no longer feel their hands, as if they had lost consciousness.
What's going on? The other party was able to withstand one of their shots without getting hurt. It was simply terrifying!
Damn it, who is this guy? How could he be so tyrannical?
Oh my god, are my eyes hallucinating? Why is the other party okay, but their spears were destroyed? Isn't this incredible? !
Just when they were stunned, Su Changge shook his body, and these people were caught off guard and were immediately blown away in all directions, and then fell hard to the ground.
Then, Su Changge sneered and said mockingly: "Is that what your men are capable of? They can't kill me. I thought your men were so powerful, but they turned out to be so weak and vulnerable. It's really shocking!"
Ziyue couldn't help but add insult to injury and said: "That's right, maybe your brain is broken, and you still want to do harm to us based on these rubbish. It's simply an idiot's dream!"
Mingyue also complained: "If you are sick, go and treat your brain. Don't go crazy here!"
"He's going to die soon. It's a waste to treat his brain. Just kill this brainless person and save the resources of the world!" Ye Qingyao also joined in.
Hearing the ridicule and sarcasm of these people, the man in the brocade robe looked extremely ugly.
He argued unconvincedly: "Don't be complacent. I just tested your depth just now. It was just an appetizer. The real killing move hasn't started yet!"
Su Changge smiled slightly and said nonchalantly: "Really? If you have any other killing moves, come on, I want to see how powerful the killing move you are talking about is."
No matter how powerful the opponent's killing moves are, in his eyes, they are actually no different than pediatrics. After all, his cultivation level is already top-notch, and he doesn't look down on him at all.
The man in brocade robes vowed: "Hmph, once you use your killing move, you will die without a single body!"
Then, he shouted to several of his followers: "You are a bunch of trash. I have almost lost all my face and dignity to you. What use do you have? If I give you another chance, you must kill him, otherwise you will not be qualified to stay with me in the future."
"Don't worry, Young Master, we will definitely cut him into pieces to vent our anger!"
"Yes, we were indeed careless just now. We thought the other party was just a little party and didn't take it seriously. Unexpectedly, we were actually plotted by the other party. No matter what, it was our mistake. It's all our fault. I promise it will never happen again!"
"Master, please don't be angry. Master must know the capabilities of us. It was just a mistake just now. He won't be proud for long!"
"Let's take him down now and let the young master calm down!"
Hearing this, the man in brocade robes softened his expression a little, and said coldly: "I hope you won't let me down this time. Otherwise, you should know what will happen to you, I don't need to tell you!"
Hearing the word "end", the four followers' hearts tightened, their faces were extremely ugly, and they couldn't help but take a breath.
The young master has very strict requirements for them. If he is dissatisfied, various punishments will be waiting for them, ranging from being transferred away to having their cultivation abolished or even being executed.
It is said that the previous group of guards were the guards who followed the young master, and their actions were not in line with the young master's wishes. Some of them were destroyed by the young master's father, and some even lost their lives.
These methods are terrifying to them just thinking about them. They don't want to end up like this, so they will definitely go all out.
At this time, Su Changge smiled faintly and suggested: "I would like to remind you that if you want to defeat me, you can't rely on them."
